dares: Let the other player order your next drink — no complaints allowed.
Speak in a movie-trailer voice for the next two rounds.
Do your best impression of the other player until they laugh.
Text your best friend only the 🥥 emoji and don't explain for an hour.
Let the other player set your phone wallpaper right now (keep it for today).
Sing the chorus of the last song you played — quietly, but committed.
Compliment the other player for 20 seconds straight without stopping.
Talk with your eyes closed until your next turn.
Do 10 seconds of your best slow-motion running while seated.
Swap one accessory (watch, cap, glasses) with the other player for the rest of the game.
Balance a spoon on your nose for 10 seconds.
Describe the other player like a nature documentary narrator would.
Let the other player pose you for a photo. They keep it.
Order your next item from the menu using only gestures.
Say the alphabet backwards — you get one attempt.
Give a 30-second TED talk on the last thing you Googled.
Arm-wrestle the other player left-handed, best of one.
Draw the other player's portrait on a napkin in 30 seconds and sign it.
Speak only in questions until your next turn.
Do your best runway walk to the counter and back (or across the room).
